title: Signed source reindexing commutes with the Hom chain comparison
statement:
theorem source_chain_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) (P I : K l E Y s) (a : ℤ)
    (eY : (hom l E Y s P I)⟦-a⟧ ≅ hom l E Y s (P⟦a⟧) I)
    (eX : (hom l E X s ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I))⟦-a⟧ ≅
      hom l E X s (((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)⟦a⟧)
        ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I))
    (hY : CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.LeftFormula.{u + 1, u, u}
      (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s) P I a eY)
    (hX : CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.LeftFormula.{u + 1, u, u}
      (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I) a eX) :
    (c.chain (P⟦a⟧) I).hom ≫
        ((podReindexingHom l E X s).map
          ((complexShift l E g s a).inv.app P).op).app
            ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I) ≫ eX.inv =
      (podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).map eY.inv ≫
        (complexShift l E g s (-a)).hom.app (hom l E Y s P I) ≫
        ((c.chain P I).hom)⟦-a⟧'

source.place: Step 4, signed source shift of the representative internal Hom. Detailed normalization uses Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A8X and 08JA, and the recorded LeftNormalization.

proof.text: Precompose by the image of eY.hom and postcompose by eX.hom. These are isomorphisms, so cancelling them reduces the conclusion to the forward signed-source square.

Apply homological-complex extensionality and Hom-product projection extensionality. Naturality of each projection under the inverse termwise shift comparison removes that source transport, whose components are identities. The target LeftFormula gives the sign (-1)^(a*r) and the projection indexed by p+a in degree r-a.

Evaluate each projected morphism at an object U and a local Hom section over V -> U. Comparison.chain_projection identifies both routes with the source-site family. Apply the source LeftFormula and linearity of section evaluation to get the identical signed family. Extensionality at every level proves equality.

proof_origin.note: Explicit specialization and factorization of the representative signed-source argument in the assigned node; the unit route is unchanged.
